title: Report: GTA 6 Guide: Door Code for Moses' Declasse Vamos Vehicle Mission
description: Video Games Chronicle publishes a guide revealing the 2727 door code needed to steal the Declasse Vamos for Moses in Grand Theft Auto 6, explaining the environmental clue location and noting a small chance the code could vary.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6: Moses Declasse Vamos Door Code Location (2727)
socialHook: VGC reveals the 2727 door code for Moses' Declasse Vamos mission in GTA 6.

sections.heading: How to Find the Door Code
paragraphs: Video Games Chronicle published a guide detailing how to obtain the door code for the Declasse Vamos vehicle in the 'Steal Vehicles For Moses' questline in Grand Theft Auto 6. According to the guide, the code is not given via a document but is visible in the environment.

sections.heading: The Code and Its Location
paragraphs: The guide states that the code '2727' appears repeatedly on the interior decor of a trailer near the barn where the Vamos is stored. Players can spot the numbers plastered across the trailer's interior after overhearing a celebration nearby. VGC notes there is a small chance the code could change, but it is unlikely.

sections.heading: What Remains Unknown
paragraphs: The guide does not specify if the code is randomized per playthrough or if it is fixed for all players. Additionally, it is unclear whether this mission is part of the main story or a side activity. Rockstar Games has not officially commented on this mission detail.
